senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; צחן, cmp. צחח , to glisten; be parched; cmp. זָהַם, to be filthy)

(b. h. offensive smell,) offensive matter. Pesik. Dibré, p. 111ᵃ אדם אוכל צ׳ וכ׳ a man may eat decayed matter two or three times, but finally he will loathe it; Yalk. Lam. 998; (Yalk. Prov. 932 צואה).
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Terumot 10:1">Ter. X, 1</cite> <he>מתיר בצ׳ וכ׳</he> allows the use of onions of T’rumah in a decayed dish, because they are applied only to absorb the froth, Maim. (R. S., v. infra).

senses.gloss: [mud-fish,] small fish preserved in brine, similar to טָרִית. Ter. l. c. מתיר בצ׳ allows the use of onions of T’rumah for boiling tsaḥănah, R. S.—
units: Ned. VI, 4 הנודר מן הצ׳ אסור בטרית וכ׳ he who vows abstinence from tsaḥănah, is forbidden to partake of hashed ṭarith. Y. ib. 39ᵈ top תמן … צ׳, v. טָרִיתָא.
